provenance.source_document: BEA Mer Rapport d'enquête technique: Abordage survenu le 7 octobre 2018 entre le roulier Ulysse et le porte-conteneurs CSL Virginia (2019)
provenance.disclaimer: All anchor state records represent verified historical evidence from the official BEA Mer casualty investigation report. Vessel was stationary at anchor awaiting charter instructions.

anchor_state.anchorage_location_description: International waters, 15 nautical miles north of Cap Corse, northern approaches to Corsica Channel
anchor_state.anchor_gear_deployed: Starboard anchor, 10 shackles in water (~275 meters of chain)
anchor_state.bridge_state: Anchor watch manned by 2nd Officer and Able Seaman lookout; X-band and S-band radars active

documented_timeline.event: Anchor dropped north of Cap Corse awaiting employment orders from charterer
Stationary at anchor; radar monitoring active; light breeze from ENE; heading 262°
Watch officer observes Ulysse closing on starboard beam; attempts VHF contact and sound signals without response
Perpendicular collision impact by Ulysse bow into starboard side between bays 22 and 26. Starboard fuel tank #3 breached.
